grammarSchedule.why: lesson 1 is `i you he she it we they`, `to be` and `not`, so `He is not ...` is writable from the first lesson
pronouns are in lesson 1, `to have` and `a/an` plus `house/car/book` in lesson 5, so `I have a house` gives a pronoun in first position followed by its verb
lesson 11 teaches `to me`, `you (object)`, `him`, `her`, `us`, `them`, `to you`; verbs to hang them on come from lesson 8
`my` and `your` sit with `name`, `friend`, `man`, `woman` in lesson 4; `his our their your (plural)` follow in lesson 12
lesson 6 teaches `this that these those` together, and nouns to point at exist from lesson 5
countable nouns arrive in lessons 4-5 and the numbers `two`/`three` in lesson 10, so `two books` is writable
`a/an` and `the` are both in lesson 5 with the first countable nouns
`there` is in lesson 6, `to be` in lesson 1 and `a/an` plus a noun in lesson 5, so `There is a house` works
lesson 8 adds the first lexical verbs (`to go to come to do to say to see to know`) to the pronouns of lesson 1; `not` for don't/doesn't is in lesson 1
`now` and `today` arrive in lesson 18; be + verb-ing needs a verb (lesson 8) and the time word that makes the tense readable
lesson 9 is the preposition set itself: `in on at to from with without for`
lesson 13 is the first adjectives (`big small good bad new old`); nouns and `to be` are already there
`very` is in lesson 2 but has nothing to modify until the adjectives of lesson 13
`and` is in lesson 2; two adjectives to join first exist in lesson 13
`best` is in lesson 41; `my` (lesson 4) and `friend` (lesson 4) complete the fixed phrase `my best friend`
`here`/`there` are in lesson 6 and `today`/`now` in lesson 18, so an end-of-clause time or place adverb is writable; the frequency adverbs `always`/`never` follow in lesson 24
`can` is in lesson 14 next to `to want`, and base verbs to follow it come from lesson 8
`would like` is in lesson 14; noun phrases (lesson 5) and to-infinitives (lesson 8 verbs plus `to` from lesson 9) are both available
`to want` and `to like` are both in lesson 14, and `to go`/`to come` from lesson 8 supply the to-infinitive
`will` is in lesson 19 together with `later` and `next`; `tomorrow` is in lesson 18
`yesterday` is in lesson 18; the verbs that take a past form (`to go to see to buy to work`) are in lessons 8 and 32, and `last` follows in lesson 19
lesson 17 is `some many much little all a lot each any`; `a/an` came in lesson 5 and the numbers in lesson 10
`and but or` are all in lesson 2, and lesson 1 already supplies two clauses to join
`because` is in lesson 20; two clauses to link exist from lesson 8 onward
determiner (lesson 5) plus adjective (lesson 13) plus noun (lesson 5) completes the order; the noun+noun pattern `bus stop` arrives in lesson 90
lesson 42 is the fixed verb+preposition set the bank actually has: `to look for`, `to belong to`, `to respond to`; the bank has no `to listen` or `to wait`

lessons.theme: in the morning, in the evening
in front and in the middle
